context: Naoko and Mei watch a cooking show about seasonal ingredients.
purpose: Two women bonding over food and seasonal cooking.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 旬の食材、使う料理ええな!
lines.en: Using seasonal ingredients in cooking — now that's what I'm talking about!
lines.style: Animated, unrestrained Kansai energy. Bright attack on the opening. Loud and generous, like she's delighting in discovering you share her passion. Warm conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 季節、感じられて、いいですね。
lines.en: You can really feel the seasons that way. That's lovely.
lines.style: Soft, genuinely pleased. Warm but measured — not performing. A small smile in the voice. Gentle pace, letting the thought settle.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Spring means bamboo shoots — absolutely no question!
lines.style: Bright Kansai exuberance. Firm on 「絶対」 — no debate. Loud and affectionate, like sharing a sacred truth. Slight lean forward in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Tender, appreciative. Soft exhale on the opening. Gently wistful — the pleasure of remembering good tastes. Pace is unhurried, savoring the thought.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Hah — I love talking about food like this!
lines.style: Genuine, open laugh. Warm Kansai brightness without forcing it. Quick pace, immediate — the laughter of someone who's found an easy friend. Generous and unselfconscious.
